explication: Amnezia is a cross-platform VPN client focused on connecting to VPN servers, including servers users deploy themselves. The documented self-hosted flow starts with server credentials, installs VPN containers, and connects through a selected protocol; the client also supports importing/managing servers, split tunneling, and API-backed subscriptions and purchases. The graph combines documented capabilities with relationships visible in sampled source. Unsampled platform and protocol implementations are represented at their exact source paths, but their internal call wiring is omitted where it was not shown.
